command: set -o pipefail; echo '=== ROOT MACHINE ACCESS ==='; for u in frankenstein-puls.service frankenstein-denker.service frankenstein-grid-autonomie.service; do printf '%s=' "$u"; sudo -n systemctl -M entityos is-active "$u" 2>&1 || true; sudo -n systemctl -M entityos show "$u" -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p FragmentPath --no-pager 2>&1 || true; done; echo '=== MACHINECTL ==='; sudo -n machinectl status entityos --no-pager 2>&1 | sed -n '1,45p'; echo '=== CURRENT MOUNTS IN CONTAINER ==='; leader=$(sudo -n machinectl show entityos -p Leader --value 2>/dev/null || true); echo LEADER=$leader; if test "${leader:-0}" -gt 0; then sudo -n nsenter -t "$leader" -m -- findmnt -T /root/.local/share/agentzero -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS 2>&1 || true; sudo -n nsenter -t "$leader" -m -- findmnt -T /root/.local/share/frank -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS 2>&1 || true; fi; echo '=== BIND HELP ==='; machinectl bind --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,80p'
